records.material: Cold-rolled austenitic stainless steel reinforcing bar
applicability: Cyclic stress-strain modelling in OpenSees Steel02
limitations: Use only for the tested material grade, diameter and stated L/D unless separately justified.
This set was calibrated with a truss representation; geometric buckling effects are embedded implicitly in the constitutive calibration.
The paper treats cR1, cR2, a2 and a4 as OpenSees recommended constants; the remaining listed Steel02 parameters were calibrated or experimentally fixed as described in the paper.

records.material: Carbon steel reinforcing bar
applicability: Cyclic stress-strain modelling in OpenSees Steel02
limitations: Use only for the tested material grade, diameter and stated L/D unless separately justified.
This set was calibrated with an explicit beam-column rebar representation; do not substitute it blindly into a fibre/truss model.
The paper treats cR1, cR2, a2 and a4 as OpenSees recommended constants; the remaining listed Steel02 parameters were calibrated or experimentally fixed as described in the paper.
